name: Razer Seiren V2 X
notes: pid 0x0543. USB mic with a headphone jack (1 input channel, 2 output channels, 48 kHz), so software monitoring runs on the device directly. It exposes a single HID interface on the Consumer page (0x000C, usage 0x01): report 0x01 carries the volume up/down keys plus a 15-byte Output, and report 0xF0 declares a 7-byte Output. There is no Razer vendor page (no 0xFF53/0xFF07) and no Chroma zone, and neither Output report has been exercised, so the app sends it nothing. Core Audio exposes its mic gain, headphone volume and a play-through (hardware sidetone) mute + volume as standard USB-Audio-Class controls.
